title: An optimized method for the extraction of ancient eukaryote DNA from marine sediments
author: Linda Armbrecht
materials: Method 1: Bead-beating + spin column (DNeasy PowerLyzer PowerSoil Kit, Qiagen; “Kit”) This technique was applied to 0.25 g of sediment subsamples stored at 4 °C , following the manufacturer's protocol with the some modifications:

Libraries from DNA extracts using the Kit, Si (Si4 and Si20), and EDTA techniques Libraries containing 2 μl input DNA (“Si4”, “Si20”) We prepared libraries from all DNA extracts (i.e., a total of 15) after Weyrich et al. (2017) with the following modifications. A 2 μl aliquot of DNA was repaired (15 min, 25°C) in a 40 μl reaction using T4 DNA polymerase (New England Biolabs). After purifying the DNA (MinElute Reaction Cleanup Kit, Qiagen), a ligation step followed (T4 DNA ligase, Fermentas) in which truncated Illumina-adapter sequences containing two unique five base-pair (bp) barcodes were attached to the double- stranded DNA (60 min, 22°C; Meyer & Kircher, 2010). An additional DNA purification (MinElute Reaction Cleanup Kit, Qiagen) step was performed, followed by a fill-in reaction with adapter sequences (Bst DNA polymerase, New England Biolabs; 30 min, 37°C, with polymer- ase deactivation for 10 min, 80°C). We then used 3 μl of the reaction- product as input for a 25 μl PCR (eight replicates per extract) with the primers IS7 and IS8 (Meyer & Kircher, 2010). Each PCR reaction in- cluded 14.2 nuclease-free H2O, 2.5 μl 10× Gold Buffer, 2.5 μl 25 mM MgCl2, 0.25 μl 25 mM dNTPs, 1.25 IS7, 1.25 IS8, and 0.1 μl AmpliTaq Gold Polymerase (Applied Biosystems). Thermal cycling specifications were as follows: 6 min at 94°C, 13 cycles of 30 s denaturation at 94°C, 30 s annealing at 60°C, 40 s extension at 72°C, and 10 min of final extension. We purified PCR products using AxyPrep magnetic beads (Axygen Biosciences; 1:1.8 library:beads) and eluted the DNA in Buffer EB (Qiagen) with 0.05% Tween 20 (Sigma Aldrich).
Method 1: Bead-beating + spin column (DNeasy PowerLyzer PowerSoil Kit, Qiagen; “Kit”) ELUTE DNA in 80 µL of Buffer EB instead of the customary C6 solution and store at -20 °C
Method 1: Bead-beating + spin column (DNeasy PowerLyzer PowerSoil Kit, Qiagen; “Kit”) RETAIN all optional 00:05:00 incubation steps at 4 °C per the kit's protocol

Method 1: Bead-beating + spin column (DNeasy PowerLyzer PowerSoil Kit, Qiagen; “Kit”) APPLY bead-beating in three runs of 00:00:20 with 00:00:05 breaks using a Precellys 24 homogenizer CENTRIFUGE at 10319 rpm for 00:00:30
Method 1: Bead-beating + spin column (DNeasy PowerLyzer PowerSoil Kit, Qiagen; “Kit”) TRANSFER sediment into individual bead-tubes using a disposable, sterile spatula

steps.title: Incubate sediment in EDTA (Method 3)
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL EDTA to each 0.25 g frozen sediment subsample in a 2 mL screw‑cap tube, place on a rotary mixer at 25 rpm and incubate overnight at room temperature; then centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 3 min, bind DNA using the Qiagen MinElute spin column and elute in 80 µL Buffer EB.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL EDTA to 0.25 g sediment in 2 mL screw‑cap tube.
Mix on rotary mixer at 25 rpm, incubate overnight at RT.
Centrifuge 13 000 rpm, 3 min.
Purify DNA with MinElute kit per manufacturer’s instructions; elute in 80 µL Buffer EB.

steps.title: Bead‑beating + liquid silica in QG buffer (Method 2)
steps.instruction: Process 0.25 g sediment subsamples (stored at 4 °C or –20 °C) by bead‑beating in QG buffer, incubate 10 min at 50 °C, centrifuge, collect supernatant, bind DNA to silica, wash, dry and elute.

substeps.instruction: Incubate sediment for 10 min at 50 °C.
Centrifuge at 14 000 rpm for 1 min; store supernatant at –20 °C.
Re‑centrifuge pellet at 14 000 rpm for 1 min, discard supernatant.
Wash pellet twice with 80 % ethanol.
Dry pellet 15 min at 37 °C.
Resuspend pellet in 80 µL Buffer EB.
Stir on rotary mixer (0 min) at RT, centrifuge 4500 rpm for 5 min, discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 900 µL DNA‑binding buffer.
Transfer supernatant to 15 mL tube containing 100 µL silica‑solution (Sigma) and 3 mL modified Buffer QG (2.7 mL Buffer QG, 46 µL H₂O, 39.08 µL Triton X‑100, 24.66 M NaCl, 164.5 M NaOAc).
Continue with manufacturer’s protocol down to step 10 (addition of Solution C3 and centrifugation).

steps.title: Combined EDTA + bead‑beating + silica (Method 4)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the combined EDTA‑treated sediment at 13 000 rpm for 3 min, keep supernatant at 4 °C, process the pellet as in Method 2, then recombine DNA solutions and perform silica binding.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 rpm, 3 min; keep supernatant at 4 °C.
Process pellet using the full Method 2 protocol.
Recombine 0.75 mL DNA solution (from pellet) with 0.75 mL EDTA supernatant to make 1.5 mL total.
Add 6 mL modified QG buffer containing 100 µL liquid silica.
Proceed as in Method 2 and elute DNA in 100 µL Buffer EB.

steps.title: Prepare 20 µL input DNA libraries (Si20_20)
steps.instruction: Using DNA extracts from the Si20 extraction (three sediment extracts and one extraction blank), take 20 µL input DNA (10× the normal amount) and construct libraries following Section 2.3.1.1 (Figure 1).

steps.title: Reverse AxyPrep purification for small fragments (Si_s)
steps.instruction: Perform a reverse AxyPrep clean‑up on each library to retain fragments ≤500 bp using two bead‑to‑library ratios and elute in Buffer EB with Tween 20.

substeps.instruction: First clean‑up: add AxyPrep beads at 1:0.4 (library:beads), incubate 15 min, place on magnetic rack 15 min, transfer supernatant to new 1.7 mL tube.
Second clean‑up: add AxyPrep beads at 1:1.2, wash twice with 80 % ethanol.
Elute DNA in 30 µL Buffer EB containing 0.05 % Tween 20.

steps.title: Quantify libraries with Qubit
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration of all libraries (23 total) using the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay (Molecular Probes).

steps.title: Create sequencing pools
steps.instruction: Design two pools: Pool 1 with 4 ng DNA per library, Pool 2 with 10 µL per extraction‑blank (EBC) library; amplify each pool by PCR (8 replicates, 25 µL reactions, Indexing Primer IS4, GAII index 1, 13 cycles).

substeps.instruction: Pool 1: combine 4 ng of each library.
Pool 2: combine 10 µL of each EBC library.
Set up eight 25 µL PCR reactions per pool using Section 2.3.1 conditions, Indexing Primer IS4, GAII index 1, 13 cycles.
Quantify post‑PCR pools with Qubit.

steps.title: Merge pools and adjust concentrations
steps.instruction: Merge the two post‑PCR pools into a third pool using 4 ng DNA from Pool 1 and 0.4 ng DNA from Pool 2; assess quality and quantity with TapeStation.

substeps.instruction: Combine 4 ng from Pool 1 with 0.4 ng from Pool 2.
Run TapeStation (Agilent) to evaluate fragment size distribution.
Perform AxyPrep clean‑up at 1:1.1 (library:beads) and repeat TapeStation check; repeat clean‑up once more to obtain a high‑quality pool (primer‑dimer minimal, 6.36 ng/µL).

steps.title: Combine libraries and size‑select
steps.instruction: Combine the four libraries to 4 ng/µL each (sediment‑derived) and 0.4 ng/µL for the EBC, perform GAII indexing PCR (Index 8), two TapeStation checks, one AxyPrep clean‑up, then two rounds of AxyBeads size‑selection followed by a dilution and final size‑selection.

substeps.instruction: Combine libraries to achieve 4 ng/µL per sediment library and 0.4 ng/µL for the EBC.
Run GAII indexing PCR (Index 8).
Perform two TapeStation checks and one AxyPrep clean‑up as in Section 2.3.1.1.
Round 1 AxyBeads purification: library:beads = 1:0.4.
Round 2 AxyBeads purification: library:beads = 1:0.6.
Dilute the pool 1:10, then repeat AxyBeads size‑selection with library:beads = 1:0.6.
Final pool: primer‑dimer nondetectable, DNA concentration 1.48 ng/µL (fragment range 147–347 bp).

steps.title: Submit final pool for sequencing
steps.instruction: Send the final library pool to the Australian Cancer Research Foundation (ACRF) Cancer Genomics Facility for Illumina NextSeq sequencing (2 × 75 bp).
